name: Eastern Mewahang
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

sources.citation: Uranw, Ram Kisun and Yadav, Dev Narayan (2009). Mewahang language: An introduction. Nepalese Linguistics 24. pp. 11-20.
sources.access_detail: a digital copy (available on request); access check: open copy online; also held in print at Harvard (Widener Library (offsite storage), call number P381.N37 N46)
sources.harvard_location: Widener Library (offsite storage), call number P381.N37 N46
sources.note: The language is not in the catalog and has no existing stress statements; this work adds nothing on stress. The open URL (himalaya.socanth.cam.ac.uk) timed out on this attempt (automated download 28, 0 bytes); the identical PDF was already held by the project from our earlier reading (downloaded via the cloudfront mirror) and was read in full. A a full-text search for stress/accent the article pages for stress/accent/tone/prominence/pitch/intonation/suprasegmental yields no hit (only the gloss 'pitch tree').

sources.citation: Gerber, Pascal. 2023. Vergleich und Rekonstruktion der Oberarun-Sprachen (Kiranti). Mit einer Skizze des Westmewahang. Inauguraldissertation, Universitaet Bern. xxvii+905 pp. DOI 10.48620/94570.
sources.access_detail: a digital copy (available on request); access check: not located online or in the libraries checked
sources.note: Nothing. Sec. 2.1 Phonologie (pp. 91-133: Konsonanteninventar, Vokalinventar, Silbenstruktur und Phonotaktik, Morphophonologie) has no accent/prosody subsection; the only 'Akzent/Betonung' mentions concern Hodgson's 1857 diacritics in Appendix C. Describes WESTERN Mewahang (Bala); p. 22 identifies Banjade 2009 and the VS 2062 dictionary intro as describing the Eastern (Yaphu) dialect.

sources.note: Nothing on word stress (only a vocative 'expressively stressed and lengthened'). Western dialect.

sources.citation: Banjade, Goma. 2009. Mewahang language: an introduction. Nepalese Linguistics 24: 11-20. (Glottolog ref 144602 lists authors as Uranw & Yadav; volume TOC and byline give Goma Banjade.) Describes the Eastern (Yaphu) dialect per Gerber 2023: 22.
sources.note: Nothing. Sec. 2 Phonology (pp. 12-14): 'The detailed study of Mewahang phonological system has not been taken yet'; lists 7 vowels with length contrast and 27 consonants with minimal pairs; no word on stress, accent or tone.
